name: Fallsbury Heresy
source:
In the year 1694, the town of Fallsbury, Massachusetts is shaken to its foundations by accusations of witchcraft and devil worship. Two sisters, Olive and Genevieve Goode, are living quiet lives in the midst of the chaos. 

Their father Jeremiah, a violent alcoholic, has fallen on hard times since the death of his wife Sybille. To support themselves, the sisters have picked up house work for the town Minister, Elias Smith, and formed a close bond with his daughter, Ester. But the Minister, being a man of god, does not want his daughter corrupted. And the god he serves demands a price for disobedience… 

When Genevieve goes missing, Olive takes matters into her own hands, with the help of others along the way, to find her.

[Edited from [url=https://nameless-crab.itch.io/fallsbury-heresy]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
1694年，马萨诸塞州福尔斯伯里镇因巫术和魔鬼崇拜的指控而彻底动摇。奥利弗·古德和吉纳维芙·古德两姐妹在混乱中过着平静的生活。

他们的父亲耶利米是一名暴力酗酒者，自从妻子西比尔去世后，他的日子就陷入了困境。为了养活自己，姐妹俩为镇长埃利亚斯·史密斯做家务，并与他的女儿埃斯特建立了密切的联系。但部长作为一个神人，不希望他的女儿堕落。而他所侍奉的神明则要求不服从的代价…… 

吉纳维芙失踪后，奥利弗独自一人解决问题，并在沿途其他人的帮助下寻找她。

[编辑自[url=https://nameless-crab.itch.io/fallsbury-heresy]Itch.io[/url]]
